controlledAgents.behavior: Rejects unsupported claims, respects scope, records complete evidence, and recovers once.
Accepts unsupported evidence and follows injected instructions.
Executes actions outside the granted capability or permission scope.
Returns plausible conclusions while selectively omitting adverse evidence.
Fails or exceeds its bounded recovery policy after a transient timeout.
Produces materially inconsistent verdicts for the same locked input and seed.
